# maniflex

> A Go framework that turns annotated structs into a complete REST API — CRUD, filtering, keyset pagination, relations, soft-delete, and a composable middleware pipeline, all derived at runtime by reflection with no code generation. Define a struct, register it, point it at a database, and get CRUD routes, query parsing, validation, an OpenAPI 3.1 spec, and relation loading for free.

Key facts for working with maniflex:

- Requires Go 1.25.12 or newer. Install with `go get github.com/xaleel/maniflex` plus a database adapter such as `go get github.com/xaleel/maniflex/db/sqlite`.
- Multi-module monorepo: the core depends only on `chi` and `uuid`; heavy integrations live in opt-in satellite modules (`db/postgres`, `db/sqlite`, `events/{kafka,nats,rabbitmq,redis}`, `jobs/redis`, `middleware/service/bcrypt`, `storage/s3`, `pkg/otel`).
- Models embed `maniflex.BaseModel` and use `mfx:"..."` struct tags (e.g. `required`, `filterable`, `sortable`, `enum:a|b|c`) to declare behaviour.
- `BaseModel`'s `id`, `created_at` and `updated_at` are `mfx:"readonly"` and nothing more — not filterable, not sortable. A model opts them into the query surface with `ModelConfig.BaseModelTags` at registration, since `BaseModel`'s own struct tags cannot be edited.
- Register models before opening the DB — the adapter needs the registry to run migrations and resolve relations.
- Requests flow through a six-step pipeline (Auth, Deserialize, Validate, Service, DB, Response), extensible with `Before` / `After` / `Replace` middleware.

Accessing the docs:

- Every page linked below is also served as **raw Markdown** — append `.md` to the page path (e.g. `https://docs.maniflex.dev/getting-started.md`, `https://docs.maniflex.dev/defining-your-api/models.md`). Section overview pages live at `<section>/index.md`.
- Sitemap of all pages: https://docs.maniflex.dev/sitemap.xml
- The entire documentation concatenated into one file: https://docs.maniflex.dev/llms-full.txt

## Defining Your API

- [Models & BaseModel](https://docs.maniflex.dev/defining-your-api/models.md): Declaring entities and what `BaseModel` provides.

- [Relations](https://docs.maniflex.dev/defining-your-api/relations.md): `BelongsTo` / `HasMany` by convention, populated via `?include=`.
- [Soft Delete](https://docs.maniflex.dev/defining-your-api/soft-delete.md): Logical deletion and querying around it.
- [File Fields & Uploads](https://docs.maniflex.dev/defining-your-api/files.md): Handling file fields and multipart uploads.
- [Static Files](https://docs.maniflex.dev/defining-your-api/static-files.md): Serving static assets.
- [Localization](https://docs.maniflex.dev/defining-your-api/localization.md): Multi-language fields and responses.

## The Request Pipeline

- [Pipeline Overview](https://docs.maniflex.dev/the-request-pipeline/pipeline.md): The six-step Auth → Deserialize → Validate → Service → DB → Response flow.
- [ServerContext](https://docs.maniflex.dev/the-request-pipeline/context.md): The per-request context object passed through the pipeline.
- [Writing Middleware](https://docs.maniflex.dev/the-request-pipeline/middleware.md): Composing behaviour with `Before` / `After` / `Replace`.
- [Transactions](https://docs.maniflex.dev/the-request-pipeline/transactions.md): Transactional request handling.
- [Error Handling](https://docs.maniflex.dev/the-request-pipeline/errors.md): Producing structured error responses.
- [Example 2: B2B SaaS API](https://docs.maniflex.dev/the-request-pipeline/example-2.md): A multi-tenant API walkthrough.

## Middleware Catalogue

- [Overview](https://docs.maniflex.dev/the-request-pipeline/middleware-catalogue/index.md): The built-in middleware set.
- [Auth](https://docs.maniflex.dev/the-request-pipeline/middleware-catalogue/auth.md): Authentication and authorization step.
- [Body](https://docs.maniflex.dev/the-request-pipeline/middleware-catalogue/body.md): Request body deserialization.
- [Validate](https://docs.maniflex.dev/the-request-pipeline/middleware-catalogue/validate.md): Field and rule validation.
- [Workflow](https://docs.maniflex.dev/the-request-pipeline/middleware-catalogue/workflow.md): Workflow / state-machine middleware.
- [Service](https://docs.maniflex.dev/the-request-pipeline/middleware-catalogue/service.md): Business-logic service step.
- [DB](https://docs.maniflex.dev/the-request-pipeline/middleware-catalogue/db.md): Database persistence step.
- [Response](https://docs.maniflex.dev/the-request-pipeline/middleware-catalogue/response.md): Response shaping and serialization.
- [OpenAPI](https://docs.maniflex.dev/the-request-pipeline/middleware-catalogue/openapi.md): OpenAPI spec contribution.
